title: Nifedipine/lidocaine commercial and territorial economics audit
status: Desk estimates before inquiries; no contact, quotes, investment or live offer assumed
scope: Exact 0.3% nifedipine/1.5% lidocaine mature cream, territorial transfer or participation; different compounds/presentations are competition, not automatically interchangeable articles.
recommendation: Downgrade the generic USD325k bridge from first-place to an incumbent-specific territory/program reserve. Reject a thin small-market royalty as a stand-alone recovery thesis; retain only a concretely valuable territory/dossier or sponsored contribution for further desk work.

source_records.limit: Selected specialist-center records/survey, not national incidence, market share, randomized effectiveness or demand for a new product.

source_records.title: Exact-combination Canadian product monograph
source_records.verified_fact: The exact 0.3%/1.5% cream was initially authorized May 30, 2024. The adult indication is chronic primary fissure unresponsive to stool softeners and topical anesthetics. The label specifies approximately 2.5–3 g twice daily for 3 weeks and a 30 g tube.
source_records.limit: Complete label-duration supply implies 105–126 g, or 4–5 whole 30 g packs. This is not an observed purchase/adherence rate and must not be applied to the different Fizurex wipe article.

assumptions_and_limits.all_numbers_in_case_and_route_models: Analyst assumptions, not quotes, calibrated probabilities, forecasts or observed contract terms.
assumptions_and_limits.initial_tranche: USD 325,000 is the prior total bounded-package planning benchmark, not a complete registration/launch budget. The model assumes initial access, legal, data and bounded development can fit inside this package; it is not a verified access fee or a claim that rights are available at this price. Any necessary entry fee beyond this package increases D. The earlier USD 175,000–625,000 range remains a scope stress, not a quotation.
assumptions_and_limits.ownership: Investor owns100% of isolated vehicle in all cases. A5% retained royalty spread is a commercial contract interest, not5% equity. No arbitrary equity dilution applied.
assumptions_and_limits.royalty_structure: Downstream licensee pays the stated royalty on its manufacturer/commercializer net sales to the vehicle; vehicle pays upstream royalty separately. Licensee funds development, manufacturing, inventory, distribution and launch. This financing/rights arrangement is assumed feasible, not offered.
assumptions_and_limits.direct_structure: Vehicle receives net product sales and bears supply, variable selling, fixed launch/commercial and development costs. Small-territory supplier margin includes upstream economics; no extra duplicate royalty. US direct has separate upstream royalty and funded development outlays.
assumptions_and_limits.existing_local_operator: The shared-operator route remains a 100% investor-owned territory vehicle. A local operator is assumed contracted, not gifted equity: USD 5,000 annual vehicle admin from year 2; USD 10,000/7,500/5,000 adverse/base/favorable annual incremental operator fixed cost from launch; USD 25,000/20,000/15,000 setup. Supply and variable selling costs still apply. These are unquoted incremental-cost assumptions, not an established operator or offer.
assumptions_and_limits.cream_units_and_adherence: The main model is a 30 g mature cream. Base 4 packs covers the lower labeled-dose end (105 g total), while favorable 5 covers the upper end (126 g); 4 does not cover every dose in the label range. Adverse 2 packs means interrupted purchase, not a full course. Compared with the preliminary unanchored 1–2 pack model, fill shares are reduced from 50/65/80% to 35/50/65% as an analyst price/adherence stress. This does not estimate elasticity. US per-course manufacturer net receipts at the main combinations are USD 100/500/1,000; patient retail/OOP can differ. The Fizurex wipe is a different unit/dose/cost model.
assumptions_and_limits.us_direct_later_development: Later-program assumptions are USD7m/12m/25m favorable/base/adverse before application fees, initial package and launch. Explicit component, confirmatory, CMC and submission scopes are in commercial-inputs.json. Favorable assumes fee waiver and year5 launch; base pays current-rate application-fee proxy on year5 filing, with launch after year5; adverse has USD5m development plus potential fee beyond the five-year horizon. These are optional continuation scenarios, not mandatory FDA programs or committed cash.
assumptions_and_limits.territory_population: 10m and300m are illustrative treatment catchments, not offered territories or exact2026 census figures. No identified10m territory is asserted vacant.
assumptions_and_limits.eligible_pool: Diagnosed annual incidence is anchored loosely to an old US cohort, then a separate 20–50% clinically eligible adult chronic/refractory fraction is assumed. The 14.2% coded 12-week follow-up is NOT used as chronic prevalence. Repeat courses are only the 1.0–1.2 courses multiplier, applied to the same captured patients; no separate lifetime-prevalence backlog is added. Recurrence does not create a new unique patient or guarantee another paid course.
assumptions_and_limits.price: Net USD5/8/15 foreign and50/125/200 US per pack are assumptions. France retailEUR9.95 and Albania CIFEUR7.06 constrain the foreign case; neither is converted into manufacturer net or a guaranteed price. US premium case needs payer acceptance despiteUSD45–55 compounding.
assumptions_and_limits.market_share: Selected capture is not observed; mature drugs, generic nitroglycerin and Fizurex constrain it. The revised favorable US case is 219,375 packs, well above the historical 47,000-pack nitroglycerin market. It requires substantial expansion/capture from compounding, so it is a demanding upside stress.
assumptions_and_limits.timing: Five years is an analyst comparison convention. Existing-program US royalty paths and independently initiated direct-US paths have distinct timelines. Ten-year continuation of already-launched branches is an explicit sensitivity; no forecast or investor deadline is inferred.
assumptions_and_limits.cash_accounting: No recycling. D=sum of new investor contributions; R=sum actual modeled distributions. Positive annual cash receives25% illustrative tax/withholding reserve; no tax credits from prior losses assumed.100% of remaining distributable cash is paid to owner after listed costs. Tax treatment is not jurisdictional advice.
assumptions_and_limits.working_capital: Annual cash aggregation nets same-year costs and receipts and does not establish peak liquidity or gross capital calls under actual payment dates. Prelaunch costs, inventory, minimum orders and collections can require extra funding. Terminal inventory value is excluded.
assumptions_and_limits.restricted_funds: Financing, development reimbursements and restricted research advances are not investor distributions. Only an unrestricted realized margin or contractual payment can contribute to R.
assumptions_and_limits.stops: These successful-continuation or delayed-development branches are scenarios, not required spend. At the325k bridge stop, absence of a funded next step means stop/expire/sell; no mandatory owner top-ups are assumed. Optional later calls shown in direct/carrying scenarios require a new decision.
assumptions_and_limits.no_fake_exit: Upfront buyer payment set to zero; required payment thresholds are solved, not predicted. Asset sale value and royalty tail beyond five years are excluded.
assumptions_and_limits.deterministic_entry_ceiling: The maximum initial package is five-year distributions minus later new contributions. A negative result means operations do not support even a free initial package within the horizon. The illustrative entry-fee ceiling subtracts USD 75,000 hypothetical non-entry initial work from that amount. That is an algebraic scope sensitivity, not a bid, valuation or quoted legal/regulatory cost. It is conditional on the entire modeled operating branch and ignores uncertainty and time value.

original_screen_hurdle.p_event: A useful decision-changing bounded-package result conditional on modeled access; not clinical healing or approval.
original_screen_hurdle.q_event: Investor receives meaningful distributable cash within the analyst five-year horizon, conditional on the useful result and modeled rights; not company financing proceeds.
original_screen_hurdle.limit: Original nominal conditional hurdle, not valuation; does not include optional later cash calls.

commercial_q_sensitivity.status: Subjective very-low-confidence economic sensitivity after competition/price audit; not approval or repayment probability.

reversal_conditions: A specific still-attainable territory or existing license relationship has independently evidenced orders/net contribution large enough to cover total cash committed.
The investor retains a transferable dossier/data/territory interest that solves a material regulatory or commercial problem; a generic published regimen or broker introduction is insufficient.
A commercializer funds subsequent registration and launch while preserving an adequate royalty spread, without uncapped owner obligations.
A genuine sponsor-funded deliverable pays a contracted fee/margin; model acceptance and collection even after negative science separately.
A cheap multi-country registration transfer with substantial retained operating contribution can change the conclusion; duplicate territories already marketed cannot be assumed available.
